text: Share of other users' counter-argument comments (source: OC_comments, a JSON list; not the OP) that contain measured logical reasoning: calm, structured inference from premises or evidence to a conclusion in a restrained tone. A comment counts if it contains this even if it also has emotional aggression; quoted text from others is ignored unless the commenter adopts it. Output is the count of such comments divided by total comments, in [0,1] (0 = none); order irrelevant. Ignore and don't use as evidence OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-yous/resolution updates, or text reporting whether the outcome occurred (generic delta/platform rule discussion remains eligible). Returns null if the list is missing or malformed, or if it is a valid empty list (share undefined).
